keep.text: Dezu is draining a neighbour: a parasite.
First nest built by Libo.
First farm built by Plotacha.
First kill: Decha caught Wuplovi.
A brain grew a new neuron (Trili). Brains are getting more complex.
Decha and Trili have formed a pod: they stay together and share food.
Decha and Trili have become best friends.
First wall built by Defle.
Locha hurt its own relative Denetri. Family betrayal.
Gridro shared energy with a neighbour: cooperation.
Bogu fed a hungry relative (Deflecha). Family care has begun.
Cannibalism! Tridro ate one of its own kind.

The first mating: two parents, one child, mixed brains.
Vira mated with a close relative. The child is weak.
